# dd keeps the column on the next line: nvim's nostartofline, not vim's first non-blank
text:
    one
    t‸wo
    three
keys:  dd
want:
    one
    t‸hree
reg:   " l two␤

# yyp puts a copy below and lands on it
text:
    ‸one
    two
keys:  yyp
want:
    one
    ‸one
    two

# J joins with one space and lands on it
text:
    ‸foo
    ␠␠bar
keys:  J
want:  foo‸ bar

# o opens a line below in insert mode
text:  ‸foo
keys:  obar
want:
    foo
    bar‸
mode:  insert
